dominant_strengths: Warm amber/coral palette on near-black creates a distinctive analytical mood that breaks from typical cold SaaS dashboards
Strong information hierarchy: alert banner, three KPI tiles, trend chart, segment bars, and root-cause notes read in a logical narrative
Tracked-out small caps labels paired with confident display numerals show typographic discipline and clear craft intent
dominant_weaknesses: Three KPI tiles feel visually identical in weight despite carrying different severities—the −$42K should dominate but competes with $318K
Segment breakdown bars use three saturated hues (orange, mint, yellow) that fight the otherwise restrained amber system, fragmenting the palette
Chart lacks axis context, gridline subtlety, and the dashed forecast line is barely distinguishable from the actual line near divergence points
fix_priorities: Re-rank KPI tiles via size or emphasis so the gap metric leads visually instead of sitting as a peer
Constrain segment bar colors to a single hue ramp or tie each to its delta sign for semantic consistency
Strengthen chart legibility: label forecast vs actual, add subtle gridlines, and clarify the gap region with a fill
Tighten card padding rhythm—alert and KPI row currently breathe more than the chart block, creating uneven vertical cadence
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral warmth and behavioral clarity are well-matched, but reflective payoff is modest because the insight feels templated rather than revelatory.
rationale.intent_fit: Solidly delivers an 'improved' dashboard card with narrative analysis layered onto metrics, though the improvement is refinement rather than reinvention.
